I replied to Ilse in our DM. I told them the possible Bay 35 move for the Tansley Parcel depot stays in that DM, and that I won't bring it up in any channel, email or anyone else's conversation.

I didn't save it to GBrain or to memory, because both are shared and other people's lookups could turn it up. For the same reason I didn't search GBrain this time: there was nothing to look up, only something to keep quiet. If the change is confirmed and Ilse wants it announced, I asked them to tell me where it should go.
